summary: Iteration 144 - Smart Invoice & Payment Links Feature Testing Complete. Backend: 10/12 tests PASSED (2 errors due to rate limiting). PublicInvoicePaymentPage (/pay/:token) works correctly without login showing invoice details, payment options (Stripe/Wallet), QR code, and share buttons.
